system.description: Once per encounter, when you are within 2 squares of Cover or Concealment, you can move to that Cover or Concealment and make a Stealth check to hide as a single Move Action.

prerequisite.text: Hidden Movement talent, and Improved Stealth talent

nodes.text: Hidden Movement talent, and Improved Stealth talent
